lines.zh: 我浮着滑过来，细长一条。
lines.en: I glide over, long and narrow.

lines.zh: 我离地不高，脚步声也没有。
lines.en: I float low, without a footstep.
I move around your flank.
Every step of mine tests something.
My shadow is too thin for a man.

lines.zh: 我换了个位置，你看不清。
lines.en: I change position; you cannot track it.
I slide along the wall.
I walk while watching your hands.
I leave and circle back.

lines.zh: 我的动作总比你早半拍。
lines.en: My moves are always half a beat early.
I approach almost silently.
I cross the gravel without a sound.

lines.zh: 我悬着，像一根竖立的针。
lines.en: I hang there like an upright needle.
I study the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 我一只手垂着，一只手抬着。
lines.en: One hand hangs; one is raised.
My ki is held tight.
I tilt my head, measuring distance.

lines.zh: 我不动，可我的影子在动。
lines.en: I am still, but my shadow moves.
I close my eyes once.

lines.zh: 我等一个你不会防的角度。
lines.en: I wait for an angle you cannot guard.
My feet never touch the ground.

lines.zh: 我在听这地方的每个响声。
lines.en: I listen to every sound here.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，气却越来越紧。
lines.en: I do not move, but my ki tightens.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀放松，看起来更危险。
lines.en: I relax my shoulders and look more dangerous.
I raise my eyes to you, calm.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你的喉咙上。
lines.en: My gaze settles on your throat.
I tilt my head and look at you for a while.

lines.zh: 你没有我预想的那么强。
lines.en: You are not as strong as I expected.

lines.zh: 内兹的眼皮，慢慢抬起来。
lines.en: Neiz's eyelid lifts slowly.
There is no anger in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我在判断你会往哪边躲。
lines.en: I am judging which way you will dodge.
I drift forward half a block.

lines.zh: 我说话很轻，你得靠近听。
lines.en: I speak softly; you must come closer.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴在你的脚边。
lines.en: My shadow lies at your feet.
You shift and I smile.
I lay a hand on my chest.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼神像在看工具。
lines.en: I look at you like a tool.
I do not think you can block me.

lines.zh: 我的气在你面前停了一停。
lines.en: My ki halts briefly before you.
I nod, faintly.
I step back and frown.
I touch the struck spot.
The smile leaves my face.
Small ki blasts, but they fall thick.
I lick the corner of my mouth and grin.
I look up and recalculate.
A thin cut opens on me.
I withdraw two blocks and reset.
I did not expect it so soon.
I glance at it, uninterested.
I flick it aside.
I nudge it with my toe.
I would rather see how you react.
I flick it up and drop it.
That is not enough to buy your life.

lines.zh: 我歪头看了看，笑了一下。
lines.en: I tilt my head, look, and smile.
One afterimage and I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我抬手指了指你，不是它。
lines.en: I point at you, not at it.
You touch me and I slide away.

lines.zh: 我像水一样让开又回来。
lines.en: I yield like water, then return.

lines.zh: 我抬手在你肩上挡了一下。
lines.en: I put a hand on your shoulder to stop you.
We brush past each other, lightly.

lines.zh: 我的身形晃了晃就散开。
lines.en: My shape sways apart and reforms.

lines.zh: 你撞了个空，我已在旁边。
lines.en: You hit nothing; I am beside you.
I retreat two steps, not clumsily.
Our ki touches once.
I nudge you aside with an elbow.
You barely move me.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，都不说话。
lines.en: We float side by side, silent.
She looks at me once, and I understand.
Our ki sits side by side.
We turn to the same spot together.
I touch her shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一个很短的手势。
lines.en: We trade one brief gesture.

lines.zh: 她比我细，动作却一样快。
lines.en: She is slimmer, and just as fast.
We hang along the same line.

lines.zh: 我们一起落下去，又一起升。
lines.en: We sink together, then rise together.

lines.zh: 她的影子叠到我的上面。
lines.en: Her shadow overlaps mine.
I bend and pick something up.
I pinch it up with my fingertips.
I look at it, then toss it aside.
I hold it to the light.
I pick it up without bending.
I hide it in my cuff.
I weigh it and pocket it.
I snatch it up in a blink.

lines.zh: 我把它折了两下才拿住。
lines.en: I fold it twice to grip it.
I stop and smile at you.
I have finished my calculation.
My ki presses toward you.

lines.zh: 我消失了半秒，出现在你侧后。
lines.en: I vanish for half a second and appear behind you.

lines.zh: 这一步之后就没有退路。
lines.en: After this step there is no going back.
I have found your blind side.
I no longer wait for you to prepare.
My shadow moves behind you.
If I move first, you are too slow.
I let out a soft breath.
You are already in my sights.
My smile never reaches my eyes.
I have picked the first line of attack.
My hand opens at my side.
The distance is just right for one blink-step.

lines.zh: 我换了三个位置，你没看清。
lines.en: I change position thrice; you miss it.
I wait at your rear left.
I bait your swing with an afterimage.
Your strikes all land on nothing.
I keep up faster than you can turn.

lines.zh: 我一直在你视线外半格。
lines.en: I stay half a block outside your sight.
I am waiting for that one breath.
You retreat; I am already there.
I am counting how many blows you have left.
I have never let you see me clearly.
I stay close and do not strike.

lines.zh: 我在你身后等你自己转过来。
lines.en: I wait behind you for you to turn.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几步能退。
lines.en: I count how many steps you can still retreat.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路一格格封了。
lines.en: I seal your escape routes one block at a time.

lines.zh: 我只是跟着，不急着碰你。
lines.en: I merely follow and take my time.
I push a palm into your chest.
My fingertips rake your arm.
I blink to your side and strike.
My knee drives into your gut.

lines.zh: 我打出残影，手指已在你肩上。
lines.en: I strike as an afterimage; my fingers are already at your shoulder.
It lands light and precise.
I sweep your guard aside.
I drop from above and stomp.
You are pushed back one step.
I strike and change position.
A knife-hand chops your neck.
You only see a streak.
I sweep the back of your knee.
I seize your collar and yank.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍在你护甲缝上。
lines.en: I slap the seam of your armor.
I shove you from behind.
I appear in midair, quietly.

lines.zh: 没有声音，我已经在那儿了。
lines.en: There was no sound; I am already there.
The air tightens first, then I do.

lines.zh: 我从一道白光里落下来。
lines.en: I drop out of a white flash.

lines.zh: 你回头时我站在两格之外。
lines.en: When you look back I stand two blocks off.
My ki arrives first, thin and cold.
This corner suddenly has someone in it.
I glance around once.
I settle, then the wind starts.
I look as if I was always there.
There is one more shadow here.
My feet hang half a foot up.
An oppressive feeling arrives with me.
I have seen you since the start.

lines.zh: 我从你背后两格处出现。
lines.en: I appear two blocks behind you.
Only my shadow lands.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的衣角，我拍灭了。
lines.en: Fire catches my hem; I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我落地时没稳住，滑了一下。
lines.en: I fail to land cleanly and skid.

lines.zh: 水让我浮不起来，我呛了。
lines.en: Water kills my float and I choke.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，我翻了半圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me half a turn.
An arrow sinks deep into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股力量困住了我的气。
lines.en: That force traps my ki.
Hunger makes my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷击穿过我，我僵了一下。
lines.en: Lightning passes through me and I lock up.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我坠下去。
lines.en: Nothing is below; I fall.
